description: Production project references must remain acyclic.
Module implementations must not reference other module implementation projects.
Contract projects must not depend on implementations, hosts, clients, or tools.
Client projects must not reference server or module projects.
Shared libraries must remain independent from server, module, client, and tool projects.
Only the server host may reference module implementation projects.
Generic Common, Utils, Utilities, and Helpers project buckets are forbidden.
Nexali.Modules namespace slices must remain free of dependency cycles.
Architecture bytecode analysis must cover every production project assembly.
